facts.fact: OpenImageIO is importable in Blender 4.5's Python; ImageBuf(path).spec().channelnames lists every pass channel and get_pixels(oiio.FLOAT) returns a (height, width, channels) array, top row first
the Normal pass is world-space: floor pixels read (0, 0, 1) though the camera looks down at 45 degrees

bpy.data.images.load of a multilayer EXR in background mode gives an Image of size (0, 0) with no pixels, and image.update() raises 'does not have any image data': read multilayer EXRs with OpenImageIO
facts.update: Error: Image 'multilayer_readback-ml.exr' does not have any image data

facts.fact: a File Output node in OPEN_EXR_MULTILAYER mode uses layer_slots (not file_slots) and writes one file, base_path + frame number + .exr, with one layer per slot
